summary:
Exhaustive Production Implementation Specification for Category Agriculture & Livestock (Exploitation Agricole & Élevage Laitier in Algeria):
- Complete feature-by-feature specifications covering all 5 Must features:
  1. Dynamic Parcel Register & Concession Passport (Cadastre, Surface, Sol, Loi 10-03, Irrigation & GPS Boundaries)
  2. Crop Cycle & Phytosanitary Safety Engine (Semis-to-Harvest State Machine, Fungicide/Herbicide Chemical Tracking, INPV Delai Avant Recolte [DAR] Mandatory Lockout)
  3. Offline Mobile Field Worker Pointage & Piecework Muster (PWA Offline IndexedDB, Tacherons Crate Tallies, Multi-Supervisor Sync, Wage Calculation)
  4. Dairy Cattle Herd & Milk Tank Engine (Individual Cow RFID/Boucle Passport, Daily Milking Session Herringbone Parlor, Antibiotic Milk Withholding Lockout, ONIL 12 DZD/L Monthly Delivery Bordereau)
  5. Farm Gate Wholesale & Weighbridge Desk (Pont-Bascule Double Pesee, Automatic Vehicle/Crate Tare Deducer, Article 317 Timbre Fiscal Gradue, Bilingual A5/Thermal BL Receipt)
- For every feature: Purpose, Business Logic with State Machines and worked numerical examples, TypeScript Quadruple Traceability Data Models, Code Architecture, UX flows (with French/Arabic/English microcopy and competitor-beating delight), all 9 Edge Case categories handled, and Acceptance Criteria.
- Strict Role-Based UI Separation (RBAC) across 4 distinct operational personas (Gerant, Chef de Culture, Zootechnicien, Magasinier) with dedicated TopBar switcher, PIN security, and screen-locked sidebars.
- Cross-feature conflict checks, Self-Review fixing 10 weakest points, thin vertical slice build order, and Definition of Done. Zero production code written.
